title: Looking for a PhD student
intro: I am recruiting a PhD student to join my group in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Montana. Beyond a strong technical background, here is what I hope you bring:

expectations.title: A life outside research
expectations.description: You enjoy life and have hobbies of your own, and you know how to keep research and the rest of your life in balance.

expectations.title: Patience and genuine curiosity
expectations.description: You are patient and enthusiastic about research, and willing to sit down and read the literature in the field carefully and thoroughly.

expectations.title: Open communication
expectations.description: You communicate thoughtfully, including about how you are feeling. When you run into difficulty, you raise it early and ask for support rather than struggling alone.

closing: If that sounds like you, I would be glad to hear from you. Please get in touch with your CV and a short note about what you would like to work on.
